name: Age of Heroes
english_description: Age of Heroes, an experimental English LDMud mudlib based on One Step Beyond (OSB). LDMud → FluffOS conversion: catalog login lands on the docks of Silvere harbour. Walkable Westway shops (Molly's Chandler, Chez Brigan) and harbour combat (Rednose the drunken sailor). The Adventurers Guild is an unfinished archive entrance. Full OSB kernel and other domains are not loaded.
